manifest: MOXIR rig fixtures — identity, datasheet numbers, photometry and the 3D model of each, with a source for every number
howToRead: Every spec is { value, src, basis }. `src` names an entry in `sources`. `basis` is EXACT (the maker's own page for this very model code), EQUIVALENT (a named fixture of the same class, because the maker publishes nothing for this field or the code could not be traced), or ASSUMED (no source; a stated guess). Nothing here was measured by us.

identification.maker: UPlight Stage Equipment (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd. — own site pro-uplight.com, store up-light.en.made-in-china.com
identification.confirmed: UP-B380F, UP-250BSW, UP-HK1915, UP-PL5403: the model code is printed as 'Model' / 'Model NO.' on the maker's page (sources A, A2, B, B2, C, C2, C3, D).
identification.notFound: UP-LA40WF, UP-Q108S, UP-YH600F, UP-YZ31P: not UPlight products — absent from all 420 listings of the maker's made-in-china store, the 73 products in the pro-uplight.com sitemap, and web searches for each code. The letters read as pinyin (YZ yanwu = smoke, YH yanhua = firework, Q qizhu = gas column): probably the rental house's own labels. The real maker/model is OWED from the rental house; until then each is modelled on a named equivalent.
identification.photos: Maker photos were used to shape the models (compared by eye); they are the makers' copyright and are NOT stored in this repository.

search.gdtf: GDTF Share (gdtf-share.com), the DIN SPEC 15800 fixture library: downloading needs an account (its public API answers {"result":false,"error":"Unauthorized."}; https://www.gdtf.eu/gdtf/share_api/share-api/ : 'A GDTF Share account is required'), and its terms (https://gdtf-share.com/landing/pages/termsAndConditions.php §9) forbid commercial use and derivative works without a licence. Whether UPlight or the equivalents are listed could not be checked without logging in — the login is the owner's hand. No GDTF geometry is used.
search.openFixtureLibrary: Open Fixture Library (MIT, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenLightingProject/open-fixture-library/master/LICENSE, checked at commit 4992b86, 2026-09-26): no UPlight fixtures; used only as a source of physical dimensions for named equivalents (below). OFL has no 3D geometry.
search.blenderDmx: BlenderDMX (GPL-3.0, https://blenderdmx.eu/docs/gdtffixture/) builds a Base > Yoke(pan) > Head(tilt) chain from GDTF files — the same node structure used here, but it needs GDTF files, so it is not used.
search.decision: No licensable 3D model of any of these fixtures exists, so each is BUILT here (fixtures/build_fixtures.py, Blender, headless) to the datasheet's outer dimensions and the maker's photos: Base / Yoke / Head / Lens nodes pivoting at the real pan and tilt axes.

beam380.product: UPlight UP-B380F, IP65 380 W beam moving head (outdoor)

size_mm.order: W x D x H (690 = height, read from the photo)

effects.value: 1 colour wheel (14), fixed gobo wheel (13+open), rotating gobo wheel, 16-facet + honeycomb prism, frost

beam380.look: Low black base box with tubular grab bars at the ends and four round connectors on the front; tall flat-sided yoke arms with chevron vents; head = a round rear drum across the tilt axis (lamp, vent-hole ring) and a long cylindrical nose to the lens.

photometry.crossCheck: ELATION-PROTEUS-HYBRID: 233,000 lux @ 15 m in its 2.0 deg beam = 52.4 Mcd, vs 50.2 Mcd here (4 % apart). The GalaxyJet's own 475,000 lux @ 10 m = 47.5 Mcd agrees with its 20 m figure under the inverse-square law.
photometry.note: maker's claim, not an independent measurement

bsw250.product: UPlight UP-250BSW (also written UP-BSW250), 250 W LED beam/spot/wash moving head

size_mm.order: L x W x H as published

pan_tilt_deg.note: not stated by the maker; typical of the class

ip.note: INDOOR fixture — note for an outdoor or damp venue

effects.value: colour wheel (7 + CRI), fixed gobo wheel, rotating gobo wheel (7+open), 3-facet prism, frost, RGB LED ring round the lens

bsw250.look: Black base with rounded ends and a colour TFT screen; rounded-top yoke arms; a cylindrical head barrel with side vent slats and a big front lens (~75% of the barrel) circled by an LED ring.

photometry.centre: centre, at its narrowest zoom (13 deg)
photometry.crossCheck: same sheet at 28 deg: 3,930 lux @ 5 m = 98 kcd; flux conservation from 13 deg predicts 79 kcd (within 20 %). Flux 10,710 lm.
photometry.note: a 250 W LED spot, not a beam/spot/wash hybrid; the UP-250BSW zooms 10-30 deg

beeEye.identified: EXACT (size and weight from an EQUIVALENT)
beeEye.product: UPlight UP-HK1915 'Hawk Eye / Bee Eye', 19 x 15 W RGBW zoom moving head

size_mm.note: Clay Paky A.leda B-EYE K10. The maker's own 325 x 188 x 396 mm (C2, C3) is implausible for a 19-lens head and is not used.

beeEye.look: Base with an LCD and a round 4-button keypad; broad flat yoke arms; a rounded-square head whose round front bezel holds 19 cup lenses in a hex (1 + 6 + 12), ~90% of the head's width.

photometry.centre: centre, at its minimum angle (4 deg)
photometry.crossCheck: PROLIGHTING-K10 gives the Clay Paky K10 5,500 lm (no lux); a uniform 4 deg cone of 5,500 lm would be 1.4 Mcd, four times this — the 19 separate cells do not add up on one axis, so the measured lux is used.
photometry.note: reseller claim, likely all colours at full

par.product: UPlight UP-PL5403, IP65 54 x 3 W RGBW LED PAR

power_w.note: not published; 54 x 3 W of LEDs

par.look: A round cast-aluminium can with deep radial cooling fins, a flat front bezel of 54 LEDs (~75% of the can), on a U-bracket of flat steel bar that folds into its own floor stand, two big black knobs at the pivots.

photometry.centre: full white; the page does not tie the lux to an angle — 25 deg (its standard lens) ASSUMED
photometry.caveat: 1 m is barely far-field for a ~200 mm LED array, so candela from it is an upper estimate
photometry.note: no brand datasheet with lux for a 54 x 3 W PAR found (3 searches)

laser.identified: NOT FOUND — modelled on an EQUIVALENT
laser.product: equivalent: Blue Sea BLLO-RGB40, 40 W RGB animation laser, IP65

size_mm.order: front W x length x front H (published 555 x 420 x 235 without handle)

laser.look: A black box, wider than tall, a raised hood at the top centre of the front face with a small output window, a vent grille across the front, in a U-bracket with side locking knobs.

photometryMethod: Every value is a maker's claim for an EQUIVALENT fixture (no UPlight page publishes lux or lumens: 0 occurrences across 38 store listings and every pro-uplight.com page, checked 2026-09-28). A lux figure is the centre of the beam at the stated distance and angle; candela = lux x distance^2. How the rig uses these: scripts/place/rig-lib.mjs 'PHOTOMETRY' and scripts/place/README.md 'Photometry'.
